lines.en: After long swimming my fins feel heavy.
One flick of my tail and the water churns.
My gills let out bubbles.
That coral. Second time now.
Something small stirs by the coral.
Blood smell upstream.
The current's with me; swimming's easy.
Seagrass tangles around my scales.

lines.zh: 沙底下那串印子是谁的。
lines.en: Whose trail is that under the sand?
The silt's stirred up. I can't see.
The wreck's boards creak underwater.
The water deepens; I follow it.
It's dark below. I'm going down.
That light on the surface blinds me.
I circle underwater, waiting for you.
My tail draws a line through the water.

lines.zh: 我在水下，能把你抛起来。
lines.en: Underwater, I can toss you up.
The water's too still. I hear no fish.

lines.zh: 我在水下把猎物翻个身。
lines.en: Underwater, I turn my prey over.
That fish — which one was it?
What's on the seabed worth biting?
Nights in woods last so long.
Coiled on the reef, I don't move.

lines.zh: 我一直想潜到那片黑里去。
lines.en: I've always wanted to dive into that black.
I watch that patch of light overhead.
I rest coiled, one eye open.
A boat's shadow slid overhead.
This coral is big enough for a city.
Who sighs behind the reef?
It's all water through my gills.
Your eyes are on the front.
Hook smell. And line.
There are coral eggs under your feet.
No scales. No shell either.
In your shadow, your legs move.

lines.zh: 我一甩尾就能把你抛起来。
lines.en: One flick of my tail throws you up.
Your bubbles are thinning.

lines.zh: 你憋气的时间，我数过了。
lines.en: I've counted how long you hold breath.
Sink and hide, or stay and watch?
You are on the bank; I am below the water.
It hurts enough to turn me over.
A white mark left on my scales.
One tumble in the surf and my scales turned.
Come closer. The venom's still there.
This body weighs more than the water.
A hook snagged the corner of my mouth.
Beneath my scales, only water.
My long body got knocked crooked.
Iron in the water makes it all taste of blood.

lines.zh: 有人从岸上扔东西砸我。
lines.en: Someone threw something at me from the shore.
My tongue moves before my teeth.
Share a piece — just one.
Fish scattered all along here. Who did it?
Let me bite one small piece. One.
Fine. I do want that bite.
The sea snake swims slow, and dares come near.
That thing in your hand is dripping.
That bright shell — can I bite through it?
Hide it? I already smelled it.
Smells like fresh little fish.

lines.zh: 你身上带着铁，压得我疼。
lines.en: You carry iron, and it weighs on me.

lines.zh: 海蛇的鳍被你蹭到，水就乱了。
lines.en: You brushed a sea snake's fin; the water churned.
Tail first. Get out of the way.

lines.zh: 水下我缠一圈，你就动不了。
lines.en: One coil underwater and you're stuck.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，压得水发闷。
lines.en: A shadow that size makes the water heavy.
I circle you underwater.
The current tangles around you.
You swim up top; I keep to the bottom.
My scales got scraped. Annoying.

lines.zh: 你搅起一层沙，看不见了。
lines.en: You kicked up silt. Now I can't see.
Seawater light rides my scales.
Eggs in the sand. We take turns.
I know the deep sea's light.
In the seagrass, only us.

lines.zh: 我掉的唱片，是海底的调子。
lines.en: The record I drop is a tune from the seabed.

lines.zh: 我绕着珊瑚游一圈，尾巴先回。
lines.en: I circle the coral; my tail returns first.
You left, me right, a pair.
You circle the coral and I forget to move.
Your scales catch the light like sunset.
This sea, I'll follow only you.
In the seagrass I coil once.
This is hard and will not chew; I keep it.
I'll wedge it in the wreck's seams.
Under the coral. Mine.
It smells of wreck timber.

lines.zh: 咬了三口，一点牙印没有。
lines.en: Three bites and not a scratch on it.

lines.zh: 这东西，也许能派上用场。
lines.en: This might come in handy.
What falls from the wreck belongs to me.
Will you trade for one of my scales?
Every bright trinket on the seabed, I claim.
It's left the school behind.
In the coral gap — counting to three.
One splash, and it is that serpent.
That little fish in the sea. Don't swim.
My fangs are aimed at its gills.
That little fish, stopped by the rocks.

lines.zh: 海里的长身子，一甩就几米。
lines.en: This long body throws itself meters at a time.
Sea snake venom acts faster than the tide.
It flicks its tail; I move.

lines.zh: 水下的漩涡，是我在等你。
lines.en: That swirl underwater is me waiting.
No roads down here. Just me.
How long can you run? I can swim longer.
On the shallows I'm quicker.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一卷，水就起漩涡。
lines.en: One curl of my tail stirs a whirlpool.
Even in shallows I can coil.
Two more steps and I can reach you.
Your feet show through the silt cloud.

lines.zh: 你我的距离，一直在缩短。
lines.en: The gap between us keeps closing.
Underwater, hiding anywhere is the same.
In the glowing water, I coil and wait.
Fast on land. The water's mine.
I have saved strength for this bite.
The venom in water works slower than teeth.
Keep struggling and my fangs sink deeper.
Get out of these waters, now.
One more foot and my fangs come out.
That's venom, not seawater.
Back off. Don't make me bite twice.
One tail slap can shatter coral.
On this seabed, I decide.
The seabed sand is unfamiliar.
This water's bitter with salt.
The current pushes me in. Easy going.
I just grew scales. Don't eat me.
I drifted here down the channel.

lines.zh: 鳞还没硬，我已经会缠了。
lines.en: Scales still soft, and I already coil.
My fins are soft; I wobble as I swim.
Who's moving down there?
Something's knocking on the wreck.
Nobody around. I'll coil up.
Fire on the surface? Impossible.

lines.zh: 水下也有硬地，撞得我头晕。
lines.en: Even underwater the ground is hard; my head spins.
My gills are drying. I need water.

lines.zh: 一百九十点血，也怕这一下。
lines.en: A hundred ninety hit points, and still that hurt.

lines.zh: 箭从鳞片缝里扎进来了。
lines.en: The arrow got in between my scales.
Light in my scale gaps. It burns.

lines.zh: 我这长身子，在水里能把人卷起来。
lines.en: This long body can coil a person underwater.
Lightning in the water numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 离开水，我这长身子就废了。
lines.en: Out of water, this long body is useless.
